concerns.text: FR-004 (hyperparameter grid ≤10) and SC-002 (paired t-test) lack explicit task coverage. T025 mentions 'grid search (≤10 combinations)' but does not explicitly define the grid or the task to generate it. T027a is marked as 'rejected' in the analyze report and has no corresponding active task to implement the paired t-test logic required by SC-002.

FR-005 (bootstrap CIs on held-out test set) and SC-005 (sensitivity analysis) have incomplete task coverage. T029b and T029c exist but are marked as 'rejected' or incomplete in the analyze report context, leaving the specific implementation of the sensitivity sweep (FR-009) and the test-set CI generation (FR-005) without a verified, active task.

FR-007 (associational framing) and SC-007 (compute feasibility) lack direct task coverage. T031c and T056 mention the framing, but T031c is marked 'rejected' in the analyze report. T042 mentions runtime optimization but does not explicitly cover the verification of the ≤6h constraint (SC-007) as a distinct task.

FR-011 (dataset size fits RAM/disk) and SC-004 (dataset completeness) have weak coverage. T059 (chunked loader) is a revision task but depends on T012g which is incomplete. T014a (validation metrics) is marked as 'rejected' in the analyze report, leaving SC-004 (measuring completeness against ≥100 target) without a confirmed active task.
Task T060 appears twice: once in 'Phase N' and once in 'Revision Tasks' with slightly different descriptions. This duplication creates ambiguity in the task list and should be consolidated.
